# Nirvana Luxe — Luxury Vacation Rentals

> Nirvana Luxe is a luxury vacation rental company offering direct-booking for premium cabins and lakefront homes in the Smoky Mountains, Tennessee and Lake Norman, North Carolina.

## Company Information

- **Company**: VKR Ventures LLC (DBA Nirvana Luxe)
- **Website**: https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com
- **Email**: reservations@vkr-ventures.com
- **Phone**: +1-704-780-1368
- **Social**: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nirvanaluxevacations/) | [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/NirvanaLuxe) | [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@nirvanaluxevacations)

## Destinations

### Sevierville & Smoky Mountains, Tennessee
Luxury cabin rentals near Dollywood, Gatlinburg, and the Great Smoky Mountains National Park. Properties feature private pools, hot tubs, game rooms, home theaters, and mountain views. Ideal for couples, families, and large groups up to 26 guests.

### Lake Norman & Charlotte, North Carolina
Lakefront vacation homes on North Carolina's largest lake. Properties include private docks, panoramic water views, and resort-style amenities. Perfect for romantic getaways, family vacations, and corporate retreats.

## Properties

- [Nirvana](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/nirvana): 4BR luxury cabin with private heated pool, hot tub, mountain views & game room near Pigeon Forge. Sleeps 14.
- [Halftime Hideaway](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/halftime-hideaway): 5BR cabin with private indoor heated pool, hot tub, home theater & multiple game rooms. Sleeps 22 in Sevierville TN.
- [Grand Prix Getaway](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/grand-prix-getaway): 6BR racing-themed cabin with private pool, arcade, home theater & mountain views. Sleeps 26 in Sevierville TN.
- [Cabin At The Summit](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/cabin-at-the-summit): Panoramic mountain views from every room, hot tub, game room in the Smoky Mountains.
- [Evergreen Escape](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/evergreen-escape): Secluded luxury cabin with hot tub, mountain views & modern amenities in Sevierville TN.
- [The Grand Sumeru](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/the-grand-sumeru): Premium mountain lodge with hot tub, game room & stunning Smoky Mountain views. Ideal for large groups.
- [Shoreside Oasis](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/shoreside-oasis): 5BR lakefront luxury home on Lake Norman with private dock & resort amenities. Sleeps 12.
- [Chalet Du Lac](https://www.nirvanaluxevacations.com/chalet-du-lac): Lakefront chalet on Lake Norman with panoramic water views, private dock & luxury finishes.

## Booking Information

- **Direct Booking Advantage**: Save 10-15% vs. Airbnb/VRBO — no service fees
- **Best Rate Guarantee**: Lowest prices when booking direct
- **Concierge Service**: Personal trip planning and local recommendations
- **Flexible Cancellation**: Policies vary by property

## Amenities Available (varies by property)

Private heated pools (indoor & outdoor), hot tubs, game rooms with arcade games, home theaters, mountain views, lakefront with private docks, fully equipped kitchens, WiFi, washer/dryer, BBQ grills, fire pits, pet-friendly options.
